_note: B15 village post office: mail, parcels and delivery nouns. Natural scenes with people using the objects; English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_poste_noun_f.hook: Drop your letter in the bright yellow POST box – it all goes to the POST office (post).
fr_poste_noun_f.why: la poste = post office, the mail

fr_adresse_noun.hook: The girl writes the ADDRESS in her very best hand – with real skill (a-DRESS).

fr_enveloppe_noun.hook: The big white ENVELOPE lies open on the desk, ready to ENVELOP the letter (ahn-VLOP).

fr_expedition_noun.hook: The explorer packs his crate for an EXPEDITION and sends it off – a dispatch (ex-pay-dee-SYON).

fr_paquet_noun.hook: The postman holds up a PACKET tied with string – a parcel (pa-KAY).

fr_choc_noun.hook: A parcel thumps down beside him and the man leaps back in SHOCK (shok).

fr_drapeau_noun.hook: The striped flag is DRAPED, OH so neatly, round its pole – DRAPE-OH (dra-PO).

fr_courrier_noun.hook: The COURIER's bag bulges with today's mail (koo-RYAY).

fr_telegramme_noun.hook: The old machine clicks and a TELEGRAM tape curls out (tay-lay-GRAM).

fr_timbre_noun.hook: A giant postage stamp is stuck on a TIMBER log – TIMBER, stamp (TAN-br).

fr_guichet_noun.hook: Lean in at the barred window and say 'GEE, SHAY, can I post this?' – the counter window (gee-SHAY).
fr_guichet_noun.why: le guichet = counter window, ticket office

fr_postier_noun.hook: The clerk in the POST cap is the POSTIER – the postal worker (pos-TYAY).

fr_poincon_noun.hook: Thump! He PUNCHES ON the letter with his wooden stamp – PUNCH-ON (pwan-SON).

fr_change_noun.hook: The little tray of coins is for CHANGE – swapping one money for another (shahnzh).

fr_emballage_noun.hook: The brown paper roll wraps your parcel like BAGGAGE – EM-BAGGAGE, packaging (ahn-ba-LAZH).

fr_philtre_noun.hook: A pink magic potion drips through a coffee FILTER – a PHILTRE (FEEL-tr).

fr_demandeur_noun.hook: She waves her form and DEMANDS service – the DEMAND-ER, the applicant (duh-mahn-DUR).

fr_expediteur_noun.hook: He slides his letter across to EXPEDITE it – the EXPEDITE-ER, the sender (ex-pay-dee-TUR).

fr_envoi_noun.hook: The ENVOY in his red sash brings a sealed letter for sending (ahn-VWA).

fr_colis_noun.hook: A COLLIE sits guarding the big parcel – COLLIE, package (ko-LEE).

fr_livraison_noun.hook: The boy LEAVES RAISINS on the doorstep – a delivery (lee-vray-ZON).

fr_remise_noun.hook: The two friends RE-MEET and hand over the parcel – a handover (ruh-MEEZ).

fr_distribution_noun.hook: The postwoman DISTRIBUTES a letter into each box (dees-tree-bu-SYON).

fr_parcelle_noun.hook: A little fenced PARCEL of land grows vegetables – a plot (par-SEL).

fr_repartition_noun.hook: The sorting tray's PARTITION splits the letters into two piles – an allocation (ray-par-tee-SYON).

fr_postal_adj.hook: The red POSTAL van waits to carry the mail (pos-TAL).
